title: 第19章 灵植峰白冷婵第20章 两日之约
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 想起林清雪，姚德龙心里微微一虚。
前些日子系统抽奖“送”
的那件粉色肚兜……咳咳，一定不能让师妹知道！
他立刻在纳戒中翻找起来。
之前几次下山去坊市，他倒是留心过坊市里那些女子喜爱的精巧玩意儿。
很快，一支通体由温润青玉雕琢而成、顶端镶嵌着几颗细小却流光溢彩的星蓝石的玉簪出现在他手中。
玉质莹润，星蓝石在光线下折射出梦幻般的点点星芒，精致而不失清雅，正合林清雪的气质。
揣好玉簪，姚德龙深吸一口气，朝着林清雪居住的小院走去。
刚走到院门口，就听见里面传来林清雪带着羞怒的清冷声音；
“……再仔细找找！
那件粉红色绣白梅的，定是那日晾晒时不见的！
落霞峰竟出了这等……这等龌龊腌臜之事！
若是被我抓住那偷衣贼，定要将他押去执法堂，扒皮抽筋！”
几个女弟子应和着，声音里也满是气愤。
姚德龙脚步一顿，老脸瞬间有些挂不住，听着粉红色二字瞬间心领神会。
他硬着头皮咳嗽两声，推开了院门。
“咳咳……清雪师妹？”
院中，林清雪俏脸含霜，柳眉倒竖，正指挥着几名女弟子翻找着什么。
看见姚德龙进来，她清冷的眸子瞬间变得锐利无比，如同两柄寒冰小剑，直刺过来！
“大师兄！
林清雪的声音冷得能掉冰渣子，“你来得正好！
落霞峰近日不太平，竟有贼人专偷……专偷女子贴身之物！
师兄身为峰中长辈，可知是何人所为？”
她刻意加重了“贴身之物”
四个字，眼神死死盯着姚德龙，仿佛要将他看穿。
德龙只觉得后背一阵发凉，强作镇定，脸上挤出“惊怒”
的表情；
“竟有此事？！
简直……简直岂有此理！
败坏我落霞峰门风！
师妹放心，此事师兄定当彻查！
绝不姑息！”
他一边义正言辞地说着，一边赶忙从袖中摸出那支青玉星蓝簪。
“对了，师妹，这是师兄今日下山，偶然在坊市看到的，觉得十分衬你清雅气质，便买了来。”
姚德龙将玉簪递过去，动作带着一丝讨好之意。
“一点心意，莫要再为那龌龊贼子气坏身子。”
林清雪的目光落在玉簪上，那温润的青玉和梦幻的星蓝石，确实让她眼眸微微一亮。
尤其是姚德龙那句“衬你清雅气质”
，让她心头的怒火瞬间消散了不少。
她接过玉簪，指尖传来玉质的温凉，轻轻摩挲了一下簪身上的细腻纹路，
content_en:
Thinking of Lin Qingxue, Yao Delong felt slightly guilty.
A few days ago, the system drew a "giveaway"
That pink bellyband... ahem, I must not let my junior sister know!
He immediately started rummaging through the ring.
When he went down the mountain to the market a few times before, he had paid attention to the exquisite gadgets that women in the market loved.
Soon, a hosta made entirely of warm sapphire and inlaid with a few small but brilliant star sapphire stones appeared in his hand.
The jade is shiny and smooth, and the star blue stone reflects dreamlike starlight under the light. It is exquisite yet elegant, which is exactly in line with Lin Qingxue's temperament.
After putting the hosta in place, Yao Delong took a deep breath and walked towards the small courtyard where Lin Qingxue lived.
As soon as I walked to the door of the courtyard, I heard Lin Qingxue's cold voice with shame and anger coming from inside;
“…Look carefully again!
The pink piece embroidered with white plum blossoms must have disappeared while drying it that day!
Such...such a nasty and shameful thing happened in Luoxia Peak!
If I catch the clothes thief, I will definitely take him to the law enforcement hall to have his skin peeled and cramped! "
Several female disciples responded, their voices full of anger.
Yao Delong paused in his steps, his old face was a little confused for a moment, and when he heard the word pink, he understood it instantly.
He coughed twice and opened the courtyard door.
"Ahem...Junior sister Qingxue?"
In the courtyard, Lin Qingxue's pretty face was frosty, her eyebrows were raised, and she was directing several female disciples to search for something.
Seeing Yao Delong come in, her cold eyes suddenly became extremely sharp, like two small ice swords, piercing towards him!
"Big brother!
? "
Lin Qingxue's voice was so cold that it could drop ice chips, "You came just in time!
Luoxia Peak has not been peaceful recently. There are thieves who specialize in stealing... specializing in stealing women's personal belongings!
As an elder in the peak, senior brother, do you know who did it? "
She deliberately emphasized the "personal things"
Four words, eyes fixed on Yao Delong, as if to see through him.
Delong felt a chill on his back, and forced himself to calm down, with "shock and anger" on his face.
expression;
"Is this happening?!
It’s simply… it’s simply unreasonable!
Destroy my reputation in Luoxia Peak!
Don't worry, junior sister, senior brother will definitely investigate this matter thoroughly!
No tolerance! "
While speaking righteously, he quickly took out the sapphire star blue hairpin from his sleeve.
"By the way, junior sister, my senior brother came down from the mountain today and saw this by chance in Fangshi. I thought it matched your elegant temperament very well, so I bought it."
Yao Delong handed over the hosta with a hint of flattery in his movements.
"A little kindness, don't get angry over that dirty thief again."
Lin Qingxue's eyes fell on the hosta. The warm sapphire and dreamy star blue stone really made her eyes light up slightly.
Especially Yao Delong’s phrase “It complements your elegant temperament”
, the anger in her heart instantly dissipated a lot.
She took the jade hairpin and felt the coolness of jade on her fingertips. She gently rubbed the delicate lines on the hairpin.
